summary: The canonical existing-PR update route requires the native PR head and branch ref to already equal the reviewed candidate SHA. For a routine repair, push that exact SHA without force, then call pr-lane-admission --update-pr with the preserved campaign/chain and previous head; the helper preserves native machine metadata and verifies readback before fresh exact-head checks qualify the candidate. Rebinding before the push conflicts with the native-head guard. Early stale-marker check failures remain history, not qualification or authority to bypass the route. A failed or uncertain body-write/readback preserves the unresolved effect; never substitute a manual body write or fabricated initial admission. This corrects governing source instructions only; canonical admission behavior, required checks, publication and installed adoption boundaries remain unchanged.
title: Push the reviewed candidate before canonical PR marker update
